forecast-period.text: A high pressure system centred over eastern SA will slowly move east into the Tasman Sea on Saturday. A cold front is forecast to move across the Bight on Saturday before moving across the southeast of SA on Sunday, with another high pressure system quickly moving into the Bight early next week.
For latest warnings go to www.bom.gov.au, subscribe to RSS feeds, call 1300 659 210* or listen for warnings on relevant TV and radio broadcasts.
* Calls to 1300 numbers cost around 27.5c incl. GST, higher from mobiles or public phones.

Dry. Morning frost about the agricultural area and pastoral districts, most likely about the southeast and Mid North districts. Possible morning fog about the agricultural areas. Maximum temperatures average to below average. Variable winds across the southeast, tending northeast to southeasterly elsewhere.

Dry, with morning frost about the northern agricultural area, Flinders and pastoral districts. Possible morning fog about the southeast. Maximum temperatures average to below average. North to northeasterly winds.

Morning frost about the northern agricultural area, Flinders and pastoral districts. Isolated showers developing about the coast during the morning, extending across the agricultural areas during the afternoon. Maximum temperatures near average. Northeast to northwesterly winds, with a southwesterly change moving across the west during the day.

text.p: Morning frost about the Flinders and pastoral districts. Isolated showers about the southeast, clearing during the afternoon. Maximum temperatures near to below average. Southwest to southeasterly winds.

Cumulative rainfall totals to the end of Sunday: Less than 1 mm about the northern agricultural area with falls between 1 to 5 mm about the southern agricultural area. Isolated falls of 5 to 15 mm possible about the Mt Lofty Ranges and the Lower South East district.
